title: 提纲提示与段落安排
goal: 识别提纲各条的写作功能；选择对应提示的段落中心句。

points.label: 识别提纲各条的写作功能
选择对应提示的段落中心句

sources.title: 大学英语四级（CET-4）：课表
sources.used: 提纲提示与段落安排的教学范围、知识点及写作小测规格

body.p: 提纲里的三类提示各有任务：原因段解释成因，影响段说明结果，建议段提出行动。同一个话题可以放在不同的段里。中心句要给出这一段任务所需的信息。

body.box: Explain why students postpone appointments. Discuss the effects of missed appointments. Suggest ways to improve attendance.

body.p: why 要求写原因，effects 要求写后果，suggest 要求写行动。This paragraph discusses the effects 只复述了提示，没有写出具体影响。

steps.d: 看 why、effects、suggest，确定这一段的任务。Explain why meetings run late 要求写原因，不写迟到的后果。
中心句把话题和原因、后果或措施连起来。Unclear agendas make meetings run late 写出了具体原因。
检查内容是否仍针对提示中的对象。建议段可写 Set a time limit for each topic。会议室的建筑历史与提示无关，不写。

cards.title: 原因与影响
rows: Explain low attendance at a campus poetry event.
Several reasons explain low attendance at the campus poetry event held last month.
The late starting time discouraged students who needed to catch the last bus home.
写出原因本身：开始时间太晚。只说有几个原因不够。
Explain delays in group reports.
There are several possible reasons for the delays in the group's recent reports.
Unclear task assignments caused members to repeat some work while leaving other sections unfinished.
写出具体成因：分工不清。
Discuss the effects of a noisy corridor.
Noise in the corridor can have several effects on students in nearby rooms.
Repeated interruptions in the corridor make it difficult for nearby students to sustain concentration.
写学生受到的影响，不写噪声从哪里来。
Discuss the effects of peer feedback.
Receiving peer feedback can affect students' work in a number of different ways.
Comments from classmates help writers notice unclear explanations before they submit their final drafts.
写出明确的结果：交稿前发现表达不清之处。

cards.title: 建议与段落范围
rows: Suggest ways to reduce unused meal bookings.
The dining service should send a cancellation reminder before each meal booking becomes final.
行动针对未用预约。
Suggest ways to improve workshop access.
The workshop should offer an evening session for students whose classes occupy the afternoon.
增设晚间场次，针对下午上课的冲突。
Discuss the effects of peer feedback.
Feedback can help writers identify unclear explanations, although reviewers may overlook some problems.
可以给效果加限定，主体仍写正面的效果。
Explain delays in group reports.
The report's attractive cover reflects the members' shared interest in modern graphic design.
离题：封面设计与报告延误无关。

body.box: A campus music room is often booked but left empty. Outline: explain a possible reason, discuss an effect on other users, and suggest a practical change. Some students reserve a room before checking their own timetable. Other students cannot find a free slot even when the room is empty.

body.p: 原因段写未核对课表就预约。影响段写其他人找不到空闲时段。建议段要改变预约或取消的流程。

body.box:
Cause: Booking before checking personal schedules can produce reservations that students later cannot use.
Effect: Unused reservations prevent other musicians from obtaining practice time through the booking system.
Suggestion: A confirmation message should ask students to release any slot they no longer need.

body.p: 确认消息是提出的措施，材料中还没有实施。建议要写成建议，不写成已经出现的结果。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 只复述提示
There are reasons why reservations remain unused in the campus music room each week.
没有写出原因。
原因与影响互换
Other musicians lose practice time because the booked room remains unavailable in the system.
这是影响，属于影响段。它没有解释预约为何没用上。
建议充当事实
The confirmation message has already eliminated every unused reservation in the booking system.
把建议写成了已有的结果，材料中没有依据。
离题扩展
The music room contains instruments with a long history in different musical traditions.
乐器的历史与预约问题无关。

items.stem: A paragraph must explain why students abandon online forms. Which sentence fulfills that function?
options: Long forms discourage students who only need to submit a simple request.
Abandoned forms delay staff responses to other requests submitted by students.
The form should show only the fields needed for each particular request.
Several consequences follow when students leave a form unfinished after starting it.
items.why: why 要求写原因。Long forms discourage students 说明表格太长让学生放弃，即第一项。

items.stem: Which sentence gives a concrete effect of group presentations?
options: This paragraph explains the effects that group presentations have on participating students.
Group presentations give students practice in coordinating explanations with other speakers.
Students choose group presentations because they prefer sharing the preparation work.
Teachers should assign clear speaking roles before students begin preparing their presentations.
items.why: 题干要具体影响。give students practice in coordinating explanations 写出了小组展示带来的结果，即第二项。第一项只复述提示。

items.stem: Which sentence belongs under 'Suggest a response to crowded lockers'?
options: Crowded lockers prevent students from storing all their sports equipment after practice.
Crowded lockers result partly from equipment left behind at the end of term.
The sports center should label storage periods and arrange regular removal of abandoned equipment.
Crowded lockers present a storage problem that deserves attention from the sports center.
items.why: Suggest 要求写行动。label 和 arrange 写出了具体办法，即第三项。

items.stem: Which center sentence adds content to 'Explain interest in campus debates'?
options: Campus debates are a subject in which many students have recently shown interest.
Growing interest in debates can affect campus discussion in several different ways.
Debate organizers should provide clearer instructions for students joining their first event.
Debates attract students by offering a structured opportunity to defend competing views.
items.why: Explain interest 要求写原因。by offering a structured opportunity 说明辩论吸引学生的原因，即第四项。第一项只复述提示。

groups.text: Students sometimes miss deadlines for borrowing camera equipment. The request form lists the deadline on a separate page that many applicants do not open. Late requests require extra checking by staff. An essay outline calls for a reason, an effect on staff, and a suggestion addressing the information problem.

items.stem: Which content belongs in the reason paragraph?
options: The separate deadline page makes essential information easy for applicants to miss.
The staff spend extra time checking requests submitted after the borrowing deadline.
The deadline should appear beside the button used to submit a borrowing request.
The equipment office needs a discussion of the effects of late borrowing requests.
items.why: 依据是 lists the deadline on a separate page that many applicants do not open。这是学生漏看截止日期的原因，即第一项。

items.stem: Complete the center sentence for the suggestion paragraph.
items.why: 问题在于截止日期印在单独一页。place the deadline beside the submission button 正好解决这一点。

groups.text: A college asks for an essay about crowded printing stations. Outline: explain a cause of congestion, discuss its effect on students, and suggest a response. Many users send large files just before class. Queues then prevent others from printing short handouts. A proposal would separate large jobs from quick printing tasks.

items.stem: What function should the first body paragraph perform?
options: Explain how last-minute large jobs contribute to queues at printing stations.
Describe how queues prevent students from obtaining short handouts before class.
Recommend separate arrangements for large jobs and short classroom handouts.
Explain why the proposal should separate large jobs from quick printing tasks.
items.why: 提纲第一项是 explain a cause。Many users send large files just before class 是原因，即第一项。

items.stem: Which sentence best introduces the effect paragraph?
options: Last-minute large files are a major reason why queues develop at the stations.
Long queues leave students unable to print brief handouts before their classes begin.
A separate service for large jobs should reduce queues at the printing stations.
The college should explain the cause of queues before discussing possible responses.
items.why: 依据是 Queues then prevent others from printing short handouts。这是拥挤带来的影响，即第二项。

items.stem: Complete the functional description of the suggestion paragraph.
items.why: 提纲最后一项是 suggest a response，对应 propose a response。解释原因属于第一段。

items.stem: Complete a center sentence responding to the proposed solution.
items.why: 依据是 A proposal would separate large jobs from quick printing tasks。用 combine 会把措施改反。

groups.text: An essay outline concerns a student vegetable stall: explain why volunteers lose interest, discuss the effect on opening hours, and recommend a change. Volunteers repeatedly receive the same unpopular shift. Several stop signing up, leaving some mornings without staff. Rotating shifts is proposed, but no change has yet been introduced.

items.stem: Which content belongs in the effect paragraph?
options: The same unpopular shift repeatedly discourages volunteers from signing up.
The stall should rotate unpopular shifts among volunteers on a regular basis.
Staff shortages leave the stall unable to open on some scheduled mornings.
The proposed rotation has already restored every scheduled morning opening.
items.why: 依据是 leaving some mornings without staff。这是志愿者减少的结果，即第三项。第一项写的是原因。

items.stem: Which center sentence develops the recommendation?
options: Volunteer interest has declined because the same people receive unpopular shifts.
Some morning openings are lost when too few volunteers agree to staff them.
Changes to volunteer schedules are an issue that the stall needs to discuss.
The stall should share unpopular shifts through a rotation among its volunteers.
items.why: 依据是 Rotating shifts is proposed。第四项写出轮换班次这一具体建议。

items.stem: Complete the description of the cause paragraph.
items.why: 原因段解释 repeated unpopular shifts 与 declining interest 的关系。材料没有提到延长营业时间。

items.stem: Complete a center sentence for the effect paragraph.
items.why: 材料写的是 some mornings without staff。evenings 在材料中没有出现。
